metadata.title: April 24, 2009 - The Bases Are Loaded
metadata.author: By Harvey Estes / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: React to a dull sermon, perhaps
De Gaulle, early in his career?
Language in which "good day" is "dydd da"
You can take them in stride
The point of using a marker?
Strike out at the singles bar?
Motion to secede endorsed for a vote?
Some of its players wear masks
Word for a lefty derived from the orientation of this grid's "diamond"
Historic way to increase women in the army?
